rationale.47a4908b: Broach, Dill noGliebe: imizila opendiwe isiza kancane kunezindlela ezihlukile, futhi ikakhulukazi emigwaqweni eminyene. OpenStreetMap cycleway=lane noma umzila wamabhayisikili osethwe kuthebhu ye-GIS (ukusetha umgwaqo).
rationale.47ac0bc3: I-CBTC ne-ETCS level 2 zigcina umkhawulo wokuphepha ngale kwejika lamabhuleki ukumboza ukungaqiniseki kwendawo nomsila wesitimela esingaphambili; abahlinzeki basebenzisa amashumi ambalwa amamitha.
rationale.47e02ea1: Ujantshi wezinga lomgwaqo usemgwaqweni noma eduze kwawo. Umehluko ofinyelela cishe emitheni ungamukelwa ngokulinganisa kabusha umgwaqo nezindlela zabahamba ngezinyawo eziseduze kwawo (unqenqema lungu-0.1–0.2 m, irempu engu-6 % imboza imitha ebangeni elicishe libe ngu-17 m). Ngale kwalokho umgwaqo, izimpambano zawo nezindawo zokungena kudinga ukwakhiwa kabusha, umhleli okufanele akubone. Kusetshenziswa futhi esiteshini sezinga lomgwaqo, lapho umhlabathi ungehla kabili kunalokhu ebudeni bamapulatifomu.
rationale.484c4f1e: EN 13803 ne-EBO §6: 130 mm okujwayelekile no-150 mm ngemibandela yezimoto ezijwayelekile; izitimela ezitshekayo (tilting) ziphezulu. Isigatshana sizohlolwa.
rationale.496629d4: Amathremu ahamba emgwaqweni alandela iphrofayela yomgwaqo; amamitha ambalwa angamakhulu ajwayelekile eziqongweni nasemigodini (isibalo sizohlolwa ngokuqhathanisa ne-BOStrab-TrR).
rationale.4975686b: Kusetshenziswa kuphela lapho igridi ye-WorldPop ingakwazi ukulayishwa: abantu esakhiweni = indawo esiyithathayo × izitezi ÷ leli nani. Izindlu eNtshonalanga Yurophu zinikeza cishe u-40 kuya ku-50 m² wendawo yokuhlala ngomuntu ngamunye; indawo yaphansi ephelele yesakhiwo (izindonga, izitebhisi, izingxenye ezabelwanayo, ukusetshenziswa kwesitezi esiphansi) inkulu cishe ngekota. Izakhiwo ezimakwe ku-OSM njengokunye ukusetshenziswa (isitolo, ihhovisi, igaraji, isonto…) azitholi bahlali.
rationale.4987e8c9: Abaqhubi bahlela ngokwewindi lokushaja elisebenzisekayo futhi bagcine ugcino lokuphambuka, izimoto nokuguga kwebhethri; u-20 % womthamo ojwayelekile uyisibalo esijwayelekile sokuhlela.
rationale.4aa6a5c7: Isiteshi se-BRT esivaliwe esinamapulatifomu nokuqoqwa kwemali yokugibela ngaphandle kwebhasi.
rationale.4ac188fa: Izitobhi ezimbalwa edolobheni ngalinye; ibanga phakathi kwazo libekwa ngamadolobha asizwayo kunokufinyelela ngezinyawo.
rationale.4b8ed820: Amaqembu ezimoto asetshenziswa kakhulu nokulungiswa ebusuku.
rationale.4d6a42db: Ukuhamba ngokubona kumele kuvumele ukuma ngaphakathi kwebanga elibonakalayo (BOStrab); kude kunezimoto zomgwaqo ngenxa yamabhuleki ajwayelekile aphansi.
rationale.4e15587c: U-4 % ngokwangempela uyibhentshimakhi ejwayelekile yembuyiselo yezezimali engqalasizindeni yomphakathi (i-CBA Guide yeKhomishini YaseYurophu, 2014, iyayisebenzisa); beka izinga abaxhasi bakho abalicelayo. Ukukhetha kwakho — kugcinwa kungaguquki ekusebenzeni kwe-Monte Carlo.
rationale.4e174e85: Ujantshi wesithathu we-750 V DC uvame kakhulu; intambo engenhla ye-1500 V DC noma ujantshi wesithathu ombozwe we-1500 V DC kwamanye amasistimu.
rationale.4e38d890: WHO 2018: umsindo wezimoto zomgwaqo ngaphansi kuka-45 dB L_night.
rationale.4ebebef5: Ukuphakama komhlaba kuvela ku-Copernicus GLO-30, imodeli yobuso emhlabeni kugridi ka-30 m efaka izakhiwo nezihlahla, enomsindo oqondile wamamitha ambalwa. Iwindi lifushane uma liqhathaniswa nobude bejika eliqondile (amamitha angamakhulu amaningana ku-radius ka-2,000 m), ngakho izinguquko zangempela zomthambeko zihlala ephrofayeleni. rationale.517ed631: Cishe i-1:450 enconyiwe ne-1:400 njengomkhawulo kujantshi onamatshe (EN 13803, kuzohlolwa). Ubude = ukutsheka / umthambeko.

rationale.5351f266: Izingxenye eziyinhloko eziwumgogodla (isibonelo imihubhe ye-S-Bahn) zifinyelela cishe ku-120 s.
rationale.538283d3: Indawo yesinyathelo ye-TSI PRM: isinyathelo sokuqala singabi ngaphezu kuka-230 mm ngaphezu kwepulatifomu. Isigatshana sizohlolwa.
rationale.5488af84: I-TSI INF ivumela kuze kufike ku-35 ‰ kolayini besivinini esiphezulu abangabagibeli kuphela, nemikhawulo ebudeni bezingxenye eziwumqansa (isigatshana sizohlolwa).

rationale.56fda0d9: I-FTA isebenzisa umhlahlandlela ka-20 % kujantshi njengephuzu lokuqhathanisa; amaqembu ezimoto zikajantshi olula mancane, ngakho umkhawulo uvamile.
rationale.578a7a12: Imizila yomgwaqo omkhulu enemizila eminingi egeleza ngokukhululeka ithwala cishe izimoto ezingu-2000 kuya ku-2400 ngehora.

Kunikezwa kuze kufike kokuphindwe kabili kwendawo yesevisi, futhi isisindo sokuhamba ngezinyawo ekukhetheni uhlobo lwezokuthutha senza ukuhamba okude kungathandeki ngokwako.
rationale.57e3d7bf: Umkhawulo wokunemba komshayeli ngesivinini sokuhamba ngezinyawo edepho, ngaphezu komumo womzimba wemoto (izibuko ziyagoqeka phezu kwezimoto ezipakiwe); izifanekiso zendlela ethathwa yimoto ejikayo zivamise ukudwetshwa ngo-0.3–0.5 m.

rationale.591f6a79: Umzimba wemoto ka-2.65–3.10 m kanye nokunyakaza nesikhala; uhlobo lomhubhe yilo olubalulekile (imihubhe emibili ehlukene iqhelelene kakhulu).

rationale.59804381: Ukufinyeleleka kwe-negative-exponential; β = 0.05/min kunciphisa isisindo somsebenzi ngesigamu njalo ngemizuzu engu-14, ebangeni elisetshenziswa ekuhambeni kokuya emsebenzini ezifundweni zokufinyeleleka zaseYurophu.

rationale.59f4a509: Isakhiwo esiphansi esijwayelekile; sithathelwa indawo yi-building:levels noma ukuphakama ÷ 3 m lapho i-OSM inakho.
rationale.59fa380f: 09 §2.1: phinda kuze kube yilapho isikhala singaphansi kwe-demand.feedback.gap noma imijikelezo engeqile ku-10.
rationale.5acd7115: Ithremu ngayinye noma imoto kajantshi olula iyazihambela.
rationale.5b2090be: Ibhasi kumele lijike ngaphakathi kwendilinga ene-radius yangaphandle engu-12.5 m (ububanzi obungu-25 m, 96/53/EC); amabhasi angu-12 m kukhathalogi abala cishe u-19–22 m. Ukuhlolwa kwendlela ethathwa yimoto ejikayo kusebenzisa inani lemoto uqobo lapho ikhathalogi inalo.
rationale.5cafc81f: Izinga lokushisa likajantshi lilandela ilanga futhi lifinyelela phezulu ntambama.
rationale.5cb64359: Imikhawulo yesivinini yasedolobheni (50 km/h ezingxenyeni eziningi zaseYurophu) ikhawulela isivinini sesevisi; umkhawulo womgwaqo uqobo uyawina.
rationale.5cd5bb5a: Uhhafu wobubanzi bemoto (2.40–2.65 m) kanye nesikhala esivundlile esicishe sibe ngu-50 mm sokugibela ezingeni.
rationale.5d016461: I-BRT ivamise ukusebenzisa amabhasi a-articulated angu-18 m anezihlalo ezicishe zibe ngu-40 kuya ku-50 nabangu-60 kuya ku-100 abemile ngokuminyana kokuhlela.
rationale.5d257f3b: Isiteshi sivamise ukufinyelelwa ngezinye izinhlobo zezokuthutha; indawo yesevisi yokuhamba ngezinyawo ikhawulela kuphela ingxenye yokuhamba ngezinyawo kuphela.
rationale.5ddc71eb: Ujantshi wasedolobheni unezikhathi zokuma ezimfushane ezeqa kaningi kodwa kancane; uhambo olulodwa kwezinhlanu luqala luphuzile.
rationale.5defeb96: Izindleko zomsindo ezimaphakathi zemoto zicishe zibe ngu-0.5–1 € cents nge-km; amanani asemkhawulweni asedolobheni ebusuku aphezulu kaningana. Lawa ngamanani aseYurophu, aguqulwe kusuka kuma-euro ka-2016 ngesici se-PPP sendawo ye-euro nokwenyuka kwamanani e-US; wafake esikhundleni ngamanani endawo uma unawo, ngoba izindleko zokungcola, zezingozi nezokuminyana zihluka kakhulu phakathi kwamazwe.
rationale.5ec50581: Umshayeli oyedwa; okuphansi kolayini abangenawo umshayeli abanabasebenzi abazulazulayo.
rationale.5ee8ef5e: I-NCHRP Report 716 inika izici zokungqubuzana ze-gamma zezindawo ezinkulu zasedolobheni (f = a·t^b·e^(c·t), t ngemizuzu). Ukulungisa ngokobude bohambo obubonwe kushintsha u-c futhi kugcine u-b.
rationale.5eeec399: Okuzenzakalelayo kwe-END Annex I ngu-23:00 kobusuku bamahora ayisishiyagalombili.
rationale.5f5e7337: Directive (EU) 2021/1226, iphuzu le-Annex (4)(b): izitimela +5 dB emajikeni ane-300 m < R ≤ 500 m nokungenani u-50 m kajantshi.
rationale.5f7b5421: Amakolishi anabafundi abayizinkulungwane ezimbalwa, amanyuvesi amakhulu asedolobheni ano-20 000 kuya ku-40 000 asabalele ezindaweni eziningana. Faka inani langempela endaweni lapho laziwa khona.
rationale.5f7c929e: I-metro ihlukaniswe ngokuphelele ngokwencazelo (isigaba selungelo lomgwaqo A, ngokuvamile enojantshi wesithathu onogesi). Olayini besivinini esiphezulu bahamba ngaphezu kwesivinini izimpambano zezinga ezivunyelwe kuso (EBO § 11(2)).
rationale.5f967098: I-Transit Costs Project: iziteshi ziyinto eyodwa ebiza kakhulu kolayini abasemihubheni; amabhokisi angajulile ashibhe kakhulu kuneziteshi ezijulile ezimbiwe.

rationale.610980b3: Uhambo phakathi komsebenzi, izitolo nezindaba ziphela ikakhulukazi ezitolo nasezinsizeni.
rationale.61bfbf46: Ujantshi onomsele emigwaqweni uqoqa ukungcola namanzi; inani elimaphakathi eliphansi.
rationale.61cf67d4: Njengemigwaqo eyinhloko, enezikhathi eziluhlaza ezimfushane nezimoto ezijikayo eziningi.
rationale.61def8a3: Izinsuku-degree zokupholisa zivamise ukubalwa ngaphezu kuka-22 °C.
rationale.627144d9: Izakhiwo, umhlaba nabamukeli kulayishwa ngaphakathi kwaleli banga kusuka kolayini. U-300 m umboza ibhendi ka-55 dB L_den yolayini abaningi basedolobheni; ulayini omkhulu osheshayo ungadinga okwengeziwe. Akulokothi kweqe i-noise.max_source_distance_m.

rationale.64e9dd97: Umkhawulo wokuphepha owengezwa ngemva komsila wesitimela esingaphambili ngaphansi kokuhlukaniswa kwesigaba esinyakazayo (CBTC); olayini besigaba esingaguquki bathola ukuhlukaniswa kwabo ezigabeni nasemabangeni okuphepha ngale kwesiginali esikhundleni salokho.
rationale.654e1984: Ukubuyekezwa kukaFishman: ukuba seduze nesiteshi sokumisa kuyisibikezeli esinamandla kakhulu sokusebenzisa amabhayisikili abelwanayo; abasebenzisi abaningi bahlala noma basebenza ngaphakathi kwamamitha ambalwa angamakhulu. rationale.6564b12f: Inani elengeziwe eliqondile kanye nelochungechunge lokuhlinzeka ngeyunithi ngayinye yesidingo sokugcina sasekhaya lingaphansi kancane kuka-1 (Type I, amathebula e-input-output); ukwengeza ukusetshenziswa kwemali yemizi (Type II) kunika cishe u-1.2–1.5.
rationale.659d278c: Amapulatifomu amabili aseceleni, izindawo zokukhosela, imishini yamathikithi, ukugibela ezingeni.
rationale.65c2225f: Ingxenye yesikhathi sokuvimba 'ukukhulula' (release): sifushane kuma-interlocking ka-elekthronikhi anezibali-axle noma ama-track circuit; side ekukhululeni ngesandla noma nge-relay.
rationale.6629fe11: Amazinga e-S-Bahn yaseJalimane angu-140 m (eBerlin) no-210 m (izitimela ezintathu zika-70 m); amanye amasistimu asebenzisa okude kakhulu.
rationale.66c2e872: Ama-constant emodeli ye-logit ayashintsha nge-log yengxenye ebonwe ihlukaniswe ngeyemodeli (Ortúzar noWillumsen, isahluko 8). Kumodeli yesidleke (nested) isinyathelo esigcwele singeqisa; ukusinciphisa kancane kwenza kuzinze.
rationale.66d6fb19: Isivinini esimaphakathi sokugibela ibhayisikili edolobheni kusuka emnyango kuya emnyango, kufakwe nokulinda ezimpambanweni, njengoba kusetshenziswa kuhlobo lwebhayisikili lwedolobha lemizuzu engu-15 (Moreno et al. 2021 babala izindawo eziyiwa kuzo ngaphakathi kwemizuzu engu-15 ngezinyawo noma ngebhayisikili). U-12 km/h uyinani eliqaphile labagibeli abadala noma abangajwayele, u-18 km/h umuntu oya emsebenzini enethiwekhi yamabhayisikili esheshayo. Ukuwela okunamarobhothi kwengeza i-walk.crossing_delay_s ngaphezulu, njengasekuhambeni ngezinyawo.
rationale.682458af: Amazinga entela yempahla aphindaphindwayo asebenzayo asukela cishe ku-0.2 % kuya ngaphezu kuka-1 % wenani lemakethe ngonyaka; imali engenayo yentela yesifunda ithatha indawo yalokhu lapho ifakiwe.
rationale.6839ef16: Ibhasi ledolobha elingu-12 m; likadizili cishe u-US$ 0.3 wezigidi, lebhethri cishe kabili kwalokho.
rationale.685f71b3: Ngezikhathi zokuminyana abantu abaningi bahamba baya maphakathi nedolobha ekuseni futhi bahamba besuka khona kusihlwa; ukwahlukana ngokwezinhlangothi kuka-55–70 % kuvamile kolayini abaphuma maphakathi (i-TCQSM directional peaking). rationale.68ecdd7c: Iziteshi ziqhelelene kakhulu kunezitobhi zendawo ukuze kugcinwe isivinini sohambo siphezulu; phakathi kwamanani ebhasi nawojantshi olula.

rationale.6ed75b3c: Okuzenzakalelayo kwe-06-gis §9.3: amapulatifomu endawo eyodwa yokushintsha (isitobhi sethremu phambi kwesiteshi, izitobhi ezimbili zamabhasi nhlangothi zombili zempambano) avamise ukuba ngaphakathi kuka-150 m komunye nomunye; uma eqhelelene kakhulu ayizitobhi ezihlukene ezidinga amagama azo.
rationale.6f0104d7: Imisebenzi yomhlaba, ukudonswa kwamanzi, izakhiwo ezincane nokuphambukiswa kwezinsiza kujantshi ophindwe kabili ohlukanisiwe ezingeni lomhlaba. Idatha ye-Transit Costs Project ibonisa ukuthi olayini abasezingeni lomhlaba babiza ingxenye yezindleko zabasemihubheni.
rationale.6f2166f6: Amathremu ahamba ngokubona; amamitha ambalwa ngale kwesitobhi anele.
rationale.6f4b6e31: Ukwabiwa kuyama kulokhu noma ku-demand.road.relative_gap, noma yikuphi okufika kuqala.
rationale.6fc38790: Ezokuthutha zomphakathi zaseNetherlands zikhokhisa cishe u-0.17–0.20 € nge-km, ujantshi wesifunda nowebanga elide waseJalimane naseSwitzerland cishe u-0.15–0.30 € nge-km ngemali egcwele; amazwe aneholo eliphansi kancane.
rationale.7099942d: I-UIC 406 ihlola ukuzinza ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwesikhathi nokubambezeleka okungahleliwe. rationale.70bee6a1: Imizuzu engu-45 ingumkhawulo ojwayelekile wokuya emsebenzini ezifundweni zokufinyeleleka kwamathuba ahlanganisiwe; u-30 no-60 angamanani ajwayelekile okuzwela.
rationale.70c1f4c0: Ukusetshenziswa kwezindawo zokumisa amabhasi eziteshini zokugcina.
rationale.70fe4c34: Ububanzi bemoto obungu-2.40–2.65 m kanye nokunyakaza kwe-kinematic nesikhala sokuphepha esicishe sibe ngu-0.3 m; u-3.60 m noma ngaphezulu uma kunezinsika ezimaphakathi.
rationale.710ea8c2: Ukuqapha isivinini esiphezulu kwe-ETCS: ukungenela kwamabhuleki ezimo eziphuthumayo kucishe kube ngu-7.5 km/h ngaphezu kwesivinini esivunyelwe ezivinini eziphansi futhi kukhula nesivinini; amasistimu e-CBTC asebenzisa imikhawulo efanayo.
rationale.7240edbb: Uhambo lwabantu abaseminyakeni yesikole luyingxenye enkulu yokusetshenziswa kwebhasi ngaphandle kokuminyana futhi luncane kujantshi.

rationale.735cf811: Amapulatifomu amade, amakamelo okulinda, ukufinyelela ngaphandle kwezitebhisi.
rationale.739f3c05: Fishman: amasistimu amaningi enza isigamu sehora sokuqala samahhala ngokubhalisa, noma akhokhise cishe idola ngohambo. Kuguqulelwa emalini yephrojekthi ngesici se-PPP; kugrafu yezokuthutha zomphakathi kubalwa njengemizuzu ngenani lesikhathi lohambo olungelona olomsebenzi.
rationale.73e756cd: Ububanzi bemoto kanye nokunyakaza, njengebanga phakathi kwamaphakathi kajantshi wethremu.

rationale.740fffed: IBhange Lomhlaba: amabhuloho aphakeme e-HSR yaseShayina anojantshi ophindwe kabili abiza cishe u-RMB 57–73 wezigidi nge-km (US$ 9–12 wezigidi, amanani ka-2014); izindleko zaseYurophu naseNyakatho Melika ziphezulu kabili kuya kahlanu.
rationale.7424a565: Ukuminyana kwantambama okujwayelekile kusukela ku-16:00 kuya ku-19:00.

rationale.75209f50: Ujantshi ogxilisiwe, intambo engenhla neziteshi zikagesi ezincane; ukwelulwa kwaseJalimane kubiza cishe u-£9.4 wezigidi nge-km kujantshi, izitobhi nezintambo.
rationale.7544bf00: Ukuthwala inqola yengane noma umthwalo ukhuphuka ngezitebhisi, ukucela usizo, noma ukuya kwesinye isitobhi. rationale.756ad73e: Ukuhamba emgwaqweni nojantshi othile obekelwe wona.

rationale.75cc3d91: Abantu abangu-4/m² ngumthwalo ojwayelekile wokuhlela wezinsiza zasedolobheni; u-6 ukuminyana okukhulu (crush).

rationale.7618b7e5: Ukubekezelela komhleli, hhayi inani lobunjiniyela; libanzi ngokwanele ukumboza umlomo wesiteshi, lincane ngokwanele ukugwema ujantshi ongahlobene.
rationale.76eb4882: Ukujika kwebhasi lasedolobheni okunethezekile; amajika entambo engenhla yebhasi lentambo athanda ama-radius amakhulu.
rationale.786279ca: Ibanga kusuka endaweni yokungqubuzana kuya emugqeni wokuma ukuze imoto elindile ingavimbi impambano; imithetho yemigwaqo yendawo iyanquma.
rationale.78b2d00b: Kwengezwa engxenyeni yohambo olubambezelekile yesivivinyo sokuzinza (simulation.stability.delayed_share).

rationale.7966a1df: Okuzenzakalelayo kwe-NMPB-2008 njengoba kusetshenziswa eFrance kusofthiwe ye-CNOSSOS; isayensi yesimo sezulu yaseHungary ithola cishe ingxenye yesithathu emini. Kusetshenziswa yimephu ephelele; umhubhe womhleli ucabanga izimo ezinhle ngaso sonke isikhathi (umkhawulo ophezulu).
rationale.797d1cf4: Isigamu somzuzu singaphansi kwalokho umgibeli we-metro akubonayo esikhaleni sesikhathi semizuzu engu-2–5.
rationale.79c22677: Uhhafu wobubanzi bomzimba wemoto (2.80–3.10 m) kanye nesikhala esicishe sibe ngu-75 mm (access.level_gap_horizontal_mm).

rationale.79fcf8ce: Isitimela sesivinini esiphezulu esingu-200 m sibiza cishe u-US$ 30–40 wezigidi.
rationale.7a391d42: Izikole zamabanga aphansi zinabafundi abacishe babe ngu-200 kuya ku-400, izikole zamabanga aphezulu u-600 kuya ku-1500. I-OpenStreetMap ayivamile ukusho ukuthi yisiphi, ngakho kusetshenziswa inani elilodwa eliphakathi; faka inani langempela endaweni lapho laziwa khona.

rationale.7abad1cd: Ukuthola indawo, ukukhiya nokuhamba kuya epulatifomini; okwengeziwe ezindaweni zokupaka eziminyene noma ezigadiwe.
rationale.7b598ece: Amathremu anephansi eliphansi anaphansi elicishe libe ngu-300–350 mm; amapulatifomu aphansi kancane ukuze kuvunyelwe ukunyakaza kwe-suspension.
rationale.7c99497d: I-UIC 406 ibiza uhlelo lwesikhathi ngokuthi luzinzile uma ukubambezeleka kuncipha ngaphakathi kwesikhathi; isigamu sehora ngemva kwesikhathi sivumela izengezo zesikhathi sohambo nezikhathi zokuvikela ukuthi zikumunce.

rationale.7f2a4d01: U-400 m wamukela isitimela sesivinini esiphezulu esingu-2 × 200 m; i-TSI INF ishiyela izwe eliyilungu ubude.
rationale.7f395061: Ukubonisa kobuso bezakhiwo kwezinga lokuqala kungumkhuba ojwayelekile wokwenza amamephu we-CNOSSOS.
rationale.7fedd139: Iziteshi ze-metro ziqhelelene ngo-0.8–1.5 km cishe maphakathi nedolobha futhi kakhulu ezindaweni ezingaphandle.
rationale.8047e465: Alikho izinga elikhona. I-palette ye-MobSimLab ikhethelwe umehluko kumamephu ayisisekelo akhanyayo namnyama; okuluhlaza kwe-S-Bahn nebhulu le-U-Bahn kulandela umkhuba ojwayelekile wamamephu aseJalimane.
rationale.80fd3030: Amaqembu amakhulu ezimoto zikajantshi anamawindi okulungisa ahleliwe avamise ukuba ngaphansi kwesilinganiso samabhasi.
rationale.8110bbb3: Iphuzu lokuqala lefomula yabagibeli; lithathele indawo ngedatha yendawo yezabelo zezinhlobo zezokuthutha.
rationale.813aa6a2: I-TCQSM inika izikhathi zesevisi yabagibeli eminyango ebanzi esezingeni cishe u-1–2 s ngomgibeli ngamunye ngokugeleza ngakunye; izitebhisi nokukhokha imali yokugibela kuzinyusa.
rationale.82f21440: Izimoto ze-metro zivamise ukucaciswa cishe ku-60 kuya ku-100 m kolayini abasebenzayo (okuphansi emadepho). Ibanga elibanzi; thatha inani lefayela lemoto uma likhona.
rationale.842c615e: Amasistimu e-DC ajwayelekile e-EN 50163; intambo engenhla ye-750 V DC yamasistimu amasha amathremu, u-600 V DC kumanethiwekhi amadala.
rationale.84562583: Umgwaqo osheshayo wasedolobheni onemizila emibili ohlangothini ngalunye uthwala cishe izimoto ezingu-1,000–2,500 ngehora ohlangothini ngalunye ngesikhathi sokuminyana; i-HCM inika cishe izimoto ezingu-1,800–1,900 ngehora ngomzila njengokugeleza kokugcwala okuyisisekelo, futhi amarobhothi nokuhlangana kwemizila kugcina ukugeleza kwehora kungaphansi kakhulu kokuphindwe kabili kwalokho. rationale.8483bb7c: Olayini bamabhasi baheha ingxenye encane yabantu abahlala eduze kwabo kunojantshi.
rationale.84b50888: Kuphezulu eduze kwamanyuvesi; abafundi abaseduze neziteshi esilinganisweni sabagibeli bawumhlahlandlela.
rationale.85210412: Izimoto azikwazi ukufinyelela emnyango endaweni yabahamba ngezinyawo: umshayeli upaka emaphethelweni ayo bese ehamba ngezinyawo. rationale.8576fca8: Uhambo olubili ezinsukwini zomsebenzi ezicishe zibe ngu-21 kanye nolumbalwa ngezimpelasonto; ukushintsha phakathi kolayini kubalwa njengohambo olulodwa kulayini ngamunye lapha, okwenyusa inani.
rationale.85a7327a: I-ILO ilinganisela ingxenye yeholo lomsebenzi emhlabeni ngaphezulu kancane kwesigamu se-GDP; amanani kazwelonke asukela cishe ku-0.4 kuya ku-0.6.
rationale.85c63891: Izindawo zesevisi ze-metro emadolobheni amakhulu zifinyelela ezabelweni zezokuthutha zomphakathi zengxenye yesithathu noma ngaphezulu.
rationale.85d9698b: Okuzenzakalelayo okubanzi phakathi kwemikhuba kajantshi (UIC) neyamabhasi (TCQSM).
rationale.85e5a435: I-49 CFR 234.225 idinga okungenani u-20 s wesexwayiso; ojantshi bavamise ukwengeza imizuzwana embalwa ukuze izivimbo zehle, ngakho inani elimaphakathi ngu-25 s. Amazwe abeka izikhathi zawo.
rationale.85eca9e8: Amabhasi a-articulated angu-18 m amabili kuya kwamane.
rationale.8606f494: Kufinyelelwa ikakhulukazi ngezokuthutha ezondlayo noma ngemoto; indawo yesevisi yokuhamba ngezinyawo iyimodeli ebuthakathaka lapha.
rationale.861eaaae: CNOSSOS-EU Annex II 2.3.1, Figure 2.3.a: umthombo A ku-0.5 m ngaphezu kwendawo yamakhanda kajantshi.
rationale.868280c0: Amabhokisi ajulile noma imigede embiwe enemigodi emide yezitebhisi ezihambayo; i-Transit Costs Project ibala ukujula nosayizi wesiteshi njengezinto eziyinhloko ezinyusa izindleko.
rationale.872eb4c8: Imisebenzi yomhlaba yesisekelo sika-300–350 km/h. rationale.87c024c7: Ekugcineni okuphansi kwebanga lomgwaqo omkhulu we-RASt 06: imigwaqo esabalalisayo enomzila owodwa ohlangothini ngalunye ithwala kusuka emakhulwini ambalwa kuya kwezicishe zibe ngu-1,000 izimoto ngehora ohlangothini ngalunye ngesikhathi sokuminyana. Inani elifanayo lisetshenziswa ekuminyaneni kwasekuseni nakwantambama; beka izibalo zomgwaqo uqobo kuthebhu ye-GIS.
rationale.88cddd96: Amathremu amisana eduze ezitobhini kodwa kumele agcine izixhumanisi (couplers) ziqhelelene.
rationale.88edd5b1: Debrezion et al. (2007): cishe u-4.2 % wezindlu no-16.4 % wempahla yezentengiselwano endaweni yesiteshi sikajantshi; uRennert (2022) uthola u-−7.4 kuya ku-+9.6 wamaphuzu emacaleni angaphezu kuka-200. rationale.8930ce39: Kusetshenziswa kuphela uma indlela ingenayo i-maxspeed tag esebenzisekayo. Imigwaqo emikhulu yasedolobheni ivamise ukukhawulelwa ku-80–100 km/h; esemakhaya iyashesha kakhulu.
rationale.896e860d: Izinhlolovo zokwakhiwa kohambo zinika izibhedlela cishe uhambo olungu-10 kuya ku-15 ngombhede ngosuku lomsebenzi, kufaka abasebenzi; isibhedlela esinemibhede engu-300 cishe siwuhambo lwezivakashi neziguli olungu-1500 uma abasebenzi (ababalwa njengemisebenzi) bekhishiwe.
rationale.898e369d: Izimoto zihamba ngakwesokudla emazweni amaningi; izwe lephrojekthi liyakubeka (ngakwesobunxele isibonelo e-GB, IE, MT, CY, JP, IN, AU, NZ, ZA, HK, SG, TH, ID).
rationale.8a053923: Isidingo sezokuthutha zomphakathi siba phezulu ekuminyaneni kwasekuseni nakwantambama; i-TCQSM inika izici zehora lokuminyana namaphrofayela abagibeli ngehora lapho ihora eliminyene kakhulu lithwala cishe u-8–13 % wabagibeli bosuku. rationale.8a07a206: Izitimela eziphakathi kwamadolobha ezidonswa yisitimela-nhloko noma ezizihambelayo.
rationale.8a7d1260: Imodeli kaBroach, Dill noGliebe yokukhetha umzila yabagibeli bamabhayisikili basePortland: abantu bagibela imizila emide ngokusobala ukuze basebenzise izindlela nemizila ehlukile. rationale.8b0b52f9: Amazwe amaningi angenisa izitimela namabhasi awo; kuphezulu lapho zakhiwa khona endaweni.
rationale.8bad379c: Kusetshenziswa kuphela uma indlela ingenayo i-maxspeed tag esebenzisekayo. Umkhawulo ojwayelekile wasedolobheni emazweni amaningi ngu-50 km/h.
rationale.8c4e9e74: Ibhasi elingu-12 m: cishe u-5 kW nge-heat pump esimweni sezulu esipholile kuze kufike cishe ku-25–30 kW ngokufudumeza nge-resistance esithwathwa.
rationale.8cd595c7: Amakalishi e-Class III angu-12 kuya ku-13 m athwala abagibeli abahlezi kuphela, ngokuvamile izihlalo ezingu-45 kuya ku-57.
rationale.8cf6c361: Kusetshenziswa indawo yokupaka esesigcawini sesiteshi noma ekhoneni elilandelayo; ekude kakhulu ayivamile ukusetshenziswa. Izindawo zokupaka amabhayisikili zivela ku-OpenStreetMap (amenity=bicycle_parking).
rationale.8e56c180: Amahhovisi nezitolo ezindaweni zeziteshi kuvamise ukubiza kancane ngaphezulu nge-m² kunezindlu.
rationale.8ebd723b: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-meta kukaWardman kwamanani ase-UK: ukulinda kubalwa cishe ku-1.5 kuya ku-2.5 ukuphindwa kwesikhathi semotweni.
rationale.90194718: 160 km/h nomkhawulo wokunethezeka (I = 100 mm esikhundleni sika-130).
rationale.90387906: Ukushintsha esitobhini noma esiteshini esisodwa akudingi ukuhamba ngezinyawo; phakathi kwezitobhi eziseduze abagibeli bamukela imizuzu embalwa ngezinyawo, cishe u-400 m. Ukuhamba kukalwa nge-demand.mode.walk_weight futhi ukushintsha ngakunye nge-demand.mode.transfer_penalty_min.
rationale.9099964c: Izakhiwo eziningi ze-OSM azinayo i-height tag. U-8 m umele isakhiwo esinezitezi ezimbili kuya kwezintathu; ekugcineni okuphansi (isitezi esisodwa noma ishede) kuvikela okuncane, okuwuhlangothi oluqaphile lwemephu. Noma yisiphi isakhiwo esingenani u-2 kuya ku-3 m ngaphezu komugqa wokubona sesivele sinika ingxenye enkulu yokuvikela kophahla.
rationale.90efecaa: Ngaphansi kakhulu kwemikhawulo yokufika ngesikhathi (recording.late_threshold_s), ngakho uhlelo lwesikhathi oluzinzile lubuyela esikhathini kubagibeli.
rationale.91702b0e: Ukushintsha imikhawulo yomshayeli; olayini abazenzakalelayo bafushane.
rationale.9266ac90: Ibanga elijwayelekile lezindleko zomnikazi nezabeluleki; i-Transit Costs Project ithola ukulethwa okuncike kakhulu kubeluleki ekugcineni okuphezulu.
rationale.92d25f50: Izivinini eziphezulu kunethremu; u-1000 m ugcina ukusheshisa okuqondile kungaphansi kuka-0.5 m/s² cishe ku-80 km/h.
rationale.946f24ae: Ukubamba kwesondo nomgwaqo; ukuphepha kwabagibeli, hhayi amabhuleki, kungumkhawulo ongokoqobo.
rationale.949ba141: Ukuqoqwa kwemali yokugibela ngaphandle kwemoto nokugibela ngayo yonke iminyango kunciphisa isikhathi sokuma.
rationale.95650c34: Isilinganiso sabantu emotweni ezinhlolovweni zikazwelonke zokuhamba cishe ngu-1.3 kuya ku-1.5, kuphansi ohambweni lokuya emsebenzini.
rationale.95b3615b: I-UIC 406 incoma cishe u-75 % ehoreni lokuminyana kolayini abanezimoto ezixubile no-60 % ngosuku; amanani azohlolwa ngokuqhathanisa nohlelo lwamanje.
rationale.95c67edc: U-50 km/h ngumkhawulo ojwayelekile ezindaweni ezakhiwe (StVO § 3(3)); amadolobha amaningi asebenzisa u-30 km/h emigwaqweni yokuhlala namanye amazwe u-60 km/h. Amathremu kujantshi ogxilisiwe emgwaqweni ahamba ngaphansi kwemithetho yezimoto zomgwaqo (BOStrab), ngakho umkhawulo womgwaqo ukhawulela isivinini sawo lapho. I-OSM maxspeed iyawina uma ikhona.
rationale.96725448: Isisekelo esihlukaniswe ngokuphelele esinocingo nokuhlukaniswa kwamazinga kuwo wonke umgwaqo; akuvamile ezingeni lomhlaba.
rationale.9676067f: Izilinganiso zamathikithi alodwa, amaphasi nohambo lwamahhala zifinyelela cishe ku-1 kuya ku-2 US$ (PPP) ngokugibela ngakunye emadolobheni amaningi. Kuguqulelwa emalini yephrojekthi njengamathebula ezindleko.
rationale.96feca27: Ingxenye yesikhathi sokuvimba 'ukwakhiwa komzila' (route formation): imizuzwana embalwa kuma-interlocking ka-elekthronikhi, isikhathi eside kuma-interlocking e-relay; isikhathi sokushintsha ishintshi esivela kukhathalogi yezishintshi siyengezwa ngaphezulu.
rationale.98062536: Umjikelezo ngamunye usebenzisa yonke imodeli, ngakho ukulungisa kuthatha isikhathi esiphindwe kangaka kunokusebenza okukodwa. Ama-constant ezinhlobo zezokuthutha avamise ukuzinza ngaphakathi kwemijikelezo emithathu kuya kwemihlanu uma izabelo kuyiyona kuphela inhloso.
rationale.984c0e4f: Isifundo esisodwa, ngakho imiphumela eyisebenzisayo ibhalwa njengekhombisayo. Okumaphakathi: i-Placer County gondola EIR (2019, isigaba 4.9) ibikezela u-62.6 dB(A) Leq ku-100 ft (30.5 m) kusuka ezindaweni zemibhoshongo, okungu-100 dB(A) njengomthombo ophuzwini phezu komhlaba oqinile (Lw = Lp + 20 log10 r + 8; ukuguqula kwe-MobSimLab). Phezulu: i-EIR yathatha inani layo lesiteshi (isiteshi se-chairlift ehlukaniswayo, 69.6 dB(A) Leq ku-54 ft, 102 dB(A)) nasekudluleni kwemibhoshongo, njengesimo esibi kakhulu. Phansi: 10 dB ngaphansi, isinqumo se-MobSimLab ngoba i-EIR nesifinyezo somsindo se-Burnaby Mountain Gondola (TransLink 2023, kusuka ku-Hemmera 2020) zombili zithi ukudlula kwemibhoshongo kuthule kuneziteshi; akukho neyodwa enikeza inani lakho. I-EIR ithi imishini ye-gondola iyefana, ngakho inani lisebenza kuzo zonke izinhlelo zezintambo (ropeway) kuze kube umthombo uzihlukanisa.
rationale.98ee91e4: Ngale kuka-500 m cishe ulayini wezokuthutha zomphakathi awuvamile ukukhuphula umamukeli ngaphezu kuka-45 dB L_den; ibanga liyahlolwa ekusebenzeni kokuzwela.
rationale.9a96ec6f: Iziteshi zakhiwa zisezingeni, ngakho ujantshi ophuma kwesinye emhlabathini othambekile kumele umukele umehluko phakathi kokuphakama kwesiteshi nomhlaba oseduze naso. Ukusebenzisa uhhafu wokwehla okuphezulu kohlobo lwezokuthutha kulokhu kushiya olunye uhhafu womthambeko womhlaba ushintsho oludlula phezu kwawo, ngakho ukuxhumana (tie-in) kodwa akuwudluliseli ujantshi ngale kokuphezulu. Ingxenye enkulu inika ukuxhumana okufushane kodwa ujantshi owumqansa eduze kwesiteshi.
rationale.9b0f8d05: OKUBAMBE INDAWO (PLACEHOLDER): umthombo wendawo yokumisa imikhumbi (Euronoise 2018 paper 477, ichweba laseBilbao) awukafundwa; isizindalwazi sawo asikwazanga ukufinyelelwa futhi iphepha alikho kuphrojekthi.
rationale.9b4cb134: Umhlahlandlela wemigwaqo ucela izimpambano ezisondele ku-engeli engu-90° ngangokunokwenzeka, ngoba impambano etshekile inde, igcina izimoto zomgwaqo kujantshi isikhathi eside futhi yenza kube nzima kubashayeli ukubuka ebudeni bolayini. Isexwayiso ngaphansi kuka-45° yisinqumo sabanakekeli okuzoqinisekiswa. Kumathremu ahamba emgwaqweni, ujantshi ohlangana nomgwaqo nge-engeli ethe ukuba yisicaba uthathwa njengohamba ebudeni bomgwaqo, hhayi owuwelayo.
rationale.9b95aafb: Ububanzi bendlela yokuphunyuka nokufinyelela kwabasebenzi njengoba kusetshenziswa emithethweni yezindawo zokusebenza (cishe u-0.9–1.2 m).
rationale.9bb0a546: Ukunikezwa phambili kwamathremu emarobhothini ezimpambanweni kungumkhuba ojwayelekile; imithetho kazwelonke yemigwaqo inquma izimo ezingenamarobhothi.
rationale.9bcf0b9a: Directive (EU) 2021/1226, iphuzu le-Annex (4)(b): amathremu +5 dB emajikeni nasezishintshini ezine-R ≤ 200 m.
rationale.9cc018d7: Ithikithi elilodwa ledolobha libiza cishe u-2–3.5 € emadolobheni aseJalimane, eFrance nase-Italy futhi cishe u-2.5–3 US$ emadolobheni ase-US; ngezici zawo ze-PPP lokho kungu-2–4.5 wamadola omhlaba wonke. Amadolobha asemazweni aneholo eliphansi abeka izimali zokugibela ziphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga lawo lamanani; u-1.5 uyawamboza.
rationale.9cfe5e3f: Kwengezwa ekuhambeni ngezinyawo komugqa oqondile phakathi kwamapulatifomu amabili esiteshi esisodwa kuze kube yilapho i-rail-model inikeza izikhathi zokusuka epulatifomini kuya kwenye kusuka ekuhlelweni kwesiteshi (ADR-0032, 06 §9.3). Cishe isethi eyodwa yezitebhisi noma ukugibela ikheshi; iziteshi ze-metro ezijulile zidinga inani eliphezulu.
rationale.9dc27bb2: Umkhuba waseJalimane: 4.00 m kolayini abathuthukisiwe kuze kufike ku-230 km/h, 4.50 m kolayini abasha kuze kufike ku-300 km/h, 3.50 m okuncane okuphelele (EBO §10).
rationale.9dc4dafd: Landela umthetho kazwelonke wolayini abakhulu: ngakwesokudla isibonelo e-DE, AT, NL, ES, PL, CZ, US; ngakwesobunxele e-GB, FR (ngaphandle kwe-Alsace-Moselle), BE, CH, IT, SE, PT, JP. Amathremu nama-metro amaningi alandela izimoto zomgwaqo.
rationale.9e52f925: Amathremu asemgwaqweni awela emarobhothini, ngakho izimoto zomgwaqo zilinda kuphela i-intergreen ngemva kokuba ithremu isidlulile (ukuphuma endaweni yokungqubuzana yethremu kanye nokuqala kokuluhlaza komgwaqo), ngokuvamile imizuzwana embalwa. Kuzoqinisekiswa ngokuqhathanisa nezikhathi zamasiginali zendawo.
rationale.9ec5a9a2: Amaphrojekthi asekelwe emabhasini anempahla ephila isikhathi esifushane (izimoto iminyaka engu-12–15); iminyaka engu-20 imboza ukuvuselelwa kwezimoto kanye. Amanethiwekhi axubile asebenzisa isikhathi eside kakhulu sezinhlobo zawo zezokuthutha.
rationale.9f5bba9f: Izivinini zezishintshi ezijwayelekile ze-DB (R 190 m 40 km/h, 300 m 50, 760 m 80, 1200 m 100) zonke zilingana ne-sqrt(100 · R / 11.8) yehliselwe phansi, ngakho ujantshi wegatsha elijikayo uhamba nokushoda kokutsheka okucishe kube ngu-100 mm futhi ungenakho ukutsheka. I-EN 13803 ivumela okwengeziwe ngemibandela (isigatshana sizohlolwa).
rationale.a07b76af: Ujantshi ohamba emgwaqweni olingana nomgwaqo awunakho ukutsheka; ujantshi wethremu nowojantshi olula ohlukanisiwe ngokuvamile kuze kufike cishe ku-100–150 mm (BOStrab-TrR, isibalo sizohlolwa).
rationale.a09e2d08: TCQSM: ukuphumula okuncane ekugcineni kokushintshana komshayeli nokubuyisela, ngokuvamile u-5–10 min noma cishe u-10 % wesikhathi somjikelezo.
rationale.a0b0e7c6: Ukuhlola kuvamise ukugcina izimali zokugibela zingaguquki ngokwangempela; amanye amadolobha ahlela ukwenyuka ngaphezu kokwenyuka kwamanani. Ukuguquguquka kwemali yokugibela kusebenza kushintsho.
rationale.a0c3e4b7: Ukusuka kwezitimela zolayini abakhulu kuvamise ukuphuza ngomzuzu noma ngaphezulu; ingxenye yesithathu yohambo olunokubambezeleka kokuqala kuwumcabango wesivivinyo onzima kodwa ojwayelekile.
rationale.a0d320aa: Izivinini zolayini eziphansi zidinga ukutsheka okuncane; izitimela zima emajikeni eziteshini.
rationale.a1556df4: Amaphasi enyanga avamise ukubiza cishe izimali zokugibela ezilodwa ezingu-20–40 (isibonelo cishe u-30 emadolobheni amaningi aseYurophu), ngakho iphasi liyazikhokhela cishe ngohambo olulodwa lokuya nokubuya ezinsukwini eziningi zomsebenzi.
rationale.a27c08c5: Izindleko zokusebenza nge-km yemoto zingezezimoto ezicishe zibe ngu-25 m (amakalishi olayini omkhulu angu-24–27 m, izimoto ze-metro angu-18–23 m). Ama-km emoto esitimela angubude baso buhlukaniswe ngaleli nani buphindwe ngama-km aso, ngakho izingxenye ezimfushane zethremu e-articulated azibalwa ngayinye njengemoto ephelele.
rationale.a37637f8: Ukwakhiwa kabusha komgwaqo kusuka onqenqemeni kuya onqenqemeni nokuphambukiswa kwezinsiza. Olayini bamathremu baseFrance balinganiselwa cishe ku-€25–30 wezigidi nge-km konke kuhlangene (Besançon €17.5 wezigidi); cishe ingxenye yesithathu yalokho ingumsebenzi womgwaqo, kuguqulwe cishe ngo-0.73 € nge-$ yomhlaba wonke (2023).
rationale.a3f71374: Uhambo olubili ngosuku lokuya emsebenzini luphindwe ngengxenye yabasebenzi abaya emsebenzini ngosuku lomsebenzi olumaphakathi (cishe u-0.8, ngemva kwekhefu, ukugula, ukusebenza isikhashana nokusebenzela ekhaya). Abasebenzi bangabantu bendawo baphindwe ngesilinganiso sokuqashwa kwezwe (iBhange Lomhlaba) sabantu abaneminyaka engu-15 nangaphezulu.
rationale.a44df481: Isondo lebhayisikili eliwela ojantshi nge-engeli ethe ukuba yisicaba lingangena esikhaleni se-flangeway noma emseleni kajantshi wethremu bese umgibeli ewa; umhlahlandlela wamabhayisikili ucela izimpambano ezisondele ku-engeli engu-90° futhi ubheka okuthe ukuba yisicaba kunokucishe kube ngu-60° njengengozi edinga ukuthi indlela ilungiswe kabusha. Kuzoqinisekiswa ngokuqhathanisa nomhlahlandlela kazwelonke wokuklama izindlela zamabhayisikili.
rationale.a463593e: Ukukhula okuvela kubantu, emisebenzini nasekuvuthweni kwenethiwekhi ngemva kokuvulwa, ngaphambi kwanoma yiluphi ushintsho lwemali yokugibela; u-0–2 % ngonyaka ibanga elijwayelekile ezibikezelweni zokuhlola.
rationale.a47496de: Uhambo olwenzeka ngemva kwalokhu nangaphambi kokuminyana kwasekuseni lubalwa kuphela esamba sosuku lomsebenzi.
rationale.a47bca4f: I-2001/290/EC ikhawulela ukutsheka kokuklama kolayini abasha besivinini esiphezulu ku-180 mm (kubonwe emthonjeni); i-EN 13803 ne-EBO §6 zinika u-160 mm njengomkhawulo ojwayelekile kujantshi onamatshe no-180 mm njengokuphezulu (kuzohlolwa).
rationale.a48cd3b6: Izimoto ze-metro zibiza cishe u-US$ 2–3.5 wezigidi ngemoto ka-20 m; izitimela ezingenamshayeli zisekugcineni okuphezulu.
rationale.a5c94711: 0.4 · V² ku-160 km/h cishe ngu-10,000 m; 0.25 · V² inika okuncane kakhulu okungu-6400 m.
rationale.a5ea12e8: Ingxenye yesikhathi sokuvimba 'ukubona nokusabela': isikhathi umshayeli asidingayo ukubona isimo esiginalini ekude noma ephuzwini lokubona futhi asabele; cishe u-0.2 min uyinani elijwayelekile lokuhlela.
rationale.a7c18f46: Inani lokudweba: uhhafu wobubanzi besakhiwo (structure gauge) (cishe u-1.6–2.0 m kusuka maphakathi kukajantshi wolayini omkhulu, EN 15273) ususwe uhhafu we-gauge, kanye nendlela yokuhamba.
rationale.a873a97d: Izisindo ezilinganayo ekuqaleni; izisindo ziwukukhetha komhleli noma kwabenzi bezinqumo futhi zenziwa zijwayeleke ukuze zihlangane zibe ngu-1.
rationale.a8bcb03b: I = a · s / g no-s ≈ 1500 mm: 0.65 m/s² wokusheshisa okuseceleni okungalingani (ukunethezeka nabagibeli abemile) kunika cishe u-100 mm; 1.0 m/s² kunika cishe u-150 mm.
rationale.a8e6418c: Amabanga okuphepha ngale kwesiginali amade nesikhala esibanzi sojantshi bamapulatifomu okumele sibuyiselwe esikhaleni solayini.
rationale.a90ed278: Izitimela ezizihambelayo ngogesi zibiza cishe u-US$ 7–10 wezigidi ngo-70–80 m.
rationale.a91d2aa9: Isikhathi sokuma sikajantshi se-TCQSM; iziteshi ezimaphakathi zifinyelela ekugcineni okuphezulu.
rationale.a9c2170c: Isevisi yedolobha ejwayelekile kusukela cishe ku-05:30 kuya ku-23:30 ngesikhala sesikhathi solayini.
rationale.a9d5eb8c: Ojantshi banokunikezwa phambili okuphelele ezimpambanweni zezinga (Vienna Convention Art. 19).
rationale.aa2ea923: Amamodeli e-NCHRP Report 716 akala isikhathi esingenazo izinjini cishe kabili kwesikhathi semotweni; i-constant ekhethekile yohlobo lwezokuthutha ithatha okusele.
rationale.aaabeda8: Amalambu omgwaqo ayakhanya imizuzwana embalwa ngaphambi kokuba izivimbo ziqale ukwehla; ukwehla kuthatha cishe u-6–10 s; impambano ibe isiqinisekiswa ukuthi ivaliwe.
rationale.abc307db: Isikhala esijwayelekile samamephu wamasu asedolobheni. Umhleli wenza igridi ibe makhaza kolayini abade kakhulu ukuze umhubhe usabalwa kabusha ngokuhlelwa ngakunye.
rationale.ac093cbb: Abashayeli ne-ATO babamba amabhuleki ngaphansi kwezinga uhlelo lokuvikela olulibhekayo, ngakho ukuma okujwayelekile akulokothi kuthinte ijika lokuvikela.
rationale.ac2ae9c7: Izindawo ezimbili eziyingozi kanye nobubanzi obungenazo izithiyo nendawo yezitebhisi noma amakheshi phakathi.
rationale.acb0cb00: Izakhiwo eziningi ze-OSM zimakwe kuphela ngokuthi building=yes; ngaphansi kwale ndawo eziyithathayo zithathwa njengamagaraji, amashede namakhiyoski futhi azitholi bahlali, kusuka kugridi ye-WorldPop noma kusayizi wesakhiwo.
rationale.acd3803b: Okuzenzakalelayo okubanzi kuzo zonke izinhlobo zikajantshi; ukuphakama kwaphansi kukhathalogi yezimoto uqobo kusukela ku-300 kuya ku-1300 mm.
rationale.ad20bdf4: I-TSI PRM ne-EN 15273-3 zinika i-bq0 = 1650 mm kujantshi oqondile wamapulatifomu angu-550 mm no-760 mm ku-gauge engu-1435 mm (kuzohlolwa); amajika engeza ukwanda kwe-gauge.
rationale.ad273cc2: Njengasekwakheni; izinsiza zinengxenye ephezulu yenani elengeziwe eliqondile.
rationale.ad44a9d8: Isikhala samarempu ekugcineni kwepulatifomu, isiginali yokusuka nebanga layo lokuphepha noma ukweqa kwesimisi (buffer stop); isikhala sojantshi bolayini sifinyelelwa ngaphandle kwesiteshi.
rationale.ad79c543: I-SBB ibala u-3 min, i-UK PPM u-5 min, i-DB u-6 min (kuphuzile kusukela ku-6:00 kuqhubeke).
rationale.adf3626a: Kuphathwa njengojantshi lapho izimpambano zivikelwe khona; uma kungenjalo ukunikezwa phambili emarobhothini.
rationale.ae0c6357: Amanani amaphakathi ezindlu nge-m² ahlukaniswe nge-GDP ngomuntu ngamunye: cishe u-0.03 e-United States, u-0.07 eFrance naseJalimane, u-0.1 noma ngaphezulu eShayina nasemadolobheni akhula ngokushesha. Kubanzi ngamabomu; faka inani lesifunda lapho laziwa khona.
rationale.ae8b99db: Umhlahlandlela we-US DOT ubeka inani lohambo lwendawo lomuntu siqu ku-50 % weholo elimaphakathi ngehora.
rationale.aea67b82: Izitimela zesifunda kukhathalogi zisukela kwezinephansi eliphansi (495–780 mm) kuya kwezimoto zaseBrithani ezinephansi eliphakeme (cishe u-1250 mm); u-780 mm ufanele ipulatifomu ejwayelekile engu-760 mm.
rationale.af400761: Amabhuleki ezimo eziphuthumayo kajantshi ngaphandle kwamabhuleki kajantshi kazibuthe.
rationale.afd81ec6: Izinsuku-degree zokufudumeza zivamise ukubalwa ngaphansi kuka-15 °C.
rationale.b069e2e7: I-Copernicus GLO-30 iyimodeli yobuso enophahla neziqongo zezihlahla. Amasampula angaphakathi kwezakhiwo ze-OSM ayasuswa, bese i-morphological opening phezu kwaleli windi (Zhang et al. 2003) isusa noma yini emncane emi ngaphezu kwendawo ezungezile: ezinye izakhiwo, imigqa yezihlahla, amabhuloho. Amagquma nemiqansa yokwakha (embankments) ebanzi kunewindi kuyahlala. Iwindi elincane kakhulu ligcina izakhiwo ezinkulu namahlathi njengomhlaba; elibanzi kakhulu lenza amagquma amancane abe yisicaba.
rationale.b0852673: Iwindi lokufika ngesikhathi le-TCQSM: kuze kufike ku-5 min kuphuzile (ezinye izikhungo zisebenzisa u-1–3 min).

rationale.bc1470c9: Isiteshi umhleli asiphawula njengesisebenzisa kabusha isakhiwo esikhona (ibhokisi lesiteshi elidala, ihholo noma amapulatifomu): ukulungisa, ukuvimbela amanzi, ukuphepha komlilo, ukufinyelela nokufakwa kwezinto esikhundleni sesakhiwo esisha. Cishe ikota yesiteshi esisha esingaphansi komhlaba sezinga lokuqala; amanani aphezulu ezakhiweni ezijulile noma ezilimele kakhulu.
rationale.bca5a22c: Isifundo esisodwa, ngakho imiphumela eyisebenzisayo ibhalwa njengekhombisayo. Izilinganiso zokudlula zezikebhe ezinkulu zasolwandle (ro-pax, 4.8–9.3 kn) ethekwini laseLivorno. Amaphepha anikeza amandla omsindo ngemitha ngayinye yomthombo womugqa, LW/m: 84.3 dB(A) (Fredianelli et al. 2020, Figure 8) no-83.1 dB(A) uma sekulungiswe ngebanga nesivinini (Nastasi et al. 2020, Figure 6), abathi 'akufanele kudidaniswe nezinga lamandla omsindo lomkhumbi ohambayo'. Injini ithatha amandla omsindo omkhumbi uqobo, ngakho i-MobSimLab iguqula nge-Lw = LW/m + 10 log10(v T), ukuthinteka komsindo okufanayo okuvela emthonjeni ophuzwini ngesivinini v njengokusuka emugqeni ngesikhathi sesilinganiso T: ku-5 kn (2.57 m/s) iphepha lokuqala elikucabangayo nesilinganiso sokudlula kwesikebhe esingu-109 ± 38 s, v T = 280 (182–378) m, okunika u-108 dB(A) (105–112 ngokungaqiniseki kwe-LW/m). Lezi yizikebhe ezinkulu, ngakho umnikazi womkhiqizo wakhetha (2026-11-16) ukugcina okubambe indawo okungezansi kwebhasi lasemanzini, i-catamaran ne-hydrofoil kuze kube umthombo umboza imikhumbi emincane. UNastasi et al. bathola ukuthi izinga likhuphuka nesivinini njengo-20.97 log10(v / 3.9 m/s); injini ayikakusebenzisi lokho.

Indlela ewela ujantshi ivamise ukwenziwa incane ngamasango noma i-maze, ngakho u-1.5 m ungukugcina okuphansi, nendlela ebanzi eyabelwanayo engu-4 m ukugcina okuphezulu. rationale.fc31f705: Iziteshi zasemaphethelweni eziqhelelene ngamakhilomitha ambalwa; ziseduze kakhulu maphakathi.

rationale.fd02d7c7: Kusetshenziswa uma i-OSM ine-building:levels kodwa ingenayo i-height; isakhiwo esingenakho kokubili sibalwa njengezitezi ezintathu.
rationale.fd06e7f5: Okuzenzakalelayo kwe-END Annex I ngu-19:00; isikhathi sakusihlwa singafinyezwa ngehora elilodwa noma amabili bese isikhathi semini noma sasebusuku selulwa ngokufanayo.

rationale.fea93dd7: Umsele obanjwe ngezindonga (U-trough) noma umqansa wokwakha obanjwe ngezindonga; phakathi kwezindleko zezinga lomhlaba nezokumba nokumboza.
rationale.feddfe7f: Kusetshenziswa kuphela uma indlela ingenayo i-maxspeed tag esebenzisekayo. Umkhawulo ojwayelekile wasedolobheni emazweni amaningi ngu-50 km/h (30 mph e-UK nasemadolobheni ase-US).
rationale.fef618f9: Ukuminyana kokuqashwa ngesigaba sokusetshenziswa (indawo yangaphakathi ephelele ngomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele) kwenyuswe cishe ngo-20 % ngendawo yaphansi ephelele nezindawo ezingenalutho.

Lokho kubamba izindawo zesevisi zokuhamba ngezinyawo nezebhayisikili zaso sonke isitobhi (i-mode.catchment_m ingaphezulu kakhulu cishe ku-1.2 km) nohambo olufushane lwemoto oluncintisana nolayini.
